# scdn.co
> Spotify’s content delivery domain serving static web assets, media files, and application resources for Spotify clients.

This domain primarily hosts CDN-backed assets rather than human-authored documentation. Useful context comes from stable asset namespaces used by Spotify’s web player, design system, support surfaces, and developer-facing web applications.

## Core Asset Domains
- [Root](https://scdn.co/): Base CDN domain for Spotify-hosted static assets and media delivery.
- [Images](https://scdn.co/images/): Common namespace for Spotify web image assets and illustrations.
- [Resources](https://scdn.co/static/): Static asset namespace used by Spotify web applications.
- [Downloadable Assets](https://scdn.co/cdn/): CDN-backed path prefix used for versioned application resources.

## Web Player Assets
- [Web Player](https://open.spotify.com/): Spotify’s browser-based music player that consumes assets from scdn.co.
- [Open Spotify Static Assets](https://open.scdn.co/): Dedicated static asset host for Spotify’s web player frontend.
- [Favicon Asset](https://open.scdn.co/cdn/images/favicon.0f31d2ea.ico): Web player favicon served from Spotify’s static CDN.
- [Open Graph Image](https://open.scdn.co/cdn/images/og-image.548bc4b7.png): Social preview image used by Spotify web properties.

## Branding and Design Assets
- [Spotify Logo Assets](https://scdn.co/images/spotify-logo.png): Commonly referenced Spotify logo image asset.
- [Spotify Icon Assets](https://scdn.co/images/spotify-icon-white.png): White Spotify icon asset for dark-background usage.
- [Brand Imagery](https://scdn.co/images/): Shared image directory for logos, icons, and promotional graphics.
- [Developer Branding Context](https://developer.spotify.com/branding-guidelines): Official branding guidance related to Spotify asset usage.

## Support and Consumer Web Surfaces
- [Spotify Support](https://support.spotify.com/): Help center whose web experience may reference shared Spotify CDN assets.
- [Spotify Account](https://www.spotify.com/account/): Account management surface using Spotify-hosted frontend resources.
- [Spotify Download](https://www.spotify.com/download/): Desktop and mobile app download page with static media assets.
- [Spotify Premium](https://www.spotify.com/premium/): Subscription information page backed by Spotify web asset pipelines.

## Developer Platform Context
- [Spotify for Developers](https://developer.spotify.com/): Main developer portal for APIs, SDKs, and integration guides.
- [Web API Reference](https://developer.spotify.com/documentation/web-api): Reference documentation for Spotify’s public Web API.
- [Web Playback SDK](https://developer.spotify.com/documentation/web-playback-sdk): Browser playback SDK documentation related to Spotify web experiences.
- [iOS SDK](https://developer.spotify.com/documentation/ios): Native iOS integration documentation for Spotify apps.
- [Android SDK](https://developer.spotify.com/documentation/android): Native Android integration documentation for Spotify apps.

## Platform Documentation
- [Authorization Guide](https://developer.spotify.com/documentation/web-api/concepts/authorization): OAuth concepts for accessing Spotify APIs securely.
- [Rate Limits](https://developer.spotify.com/documentation/web-api/concepts/rate-limits): Guidance on request throttling and API usage limits.
- [Scopes](https://developer.spotify.com/documentation/web-api/concepts/scopes): Permission scopes required for Spotify API access.
- [Player Endpoints](https://developer.spotify.com/documentation/web-api/reference/#category-player): API endpoints for controlling playback and devices.

## Open Access and Embedded Experiences
- [Spotify Embed](https://developer.spotify.com/documentation/embeds): Documentation for embedding Spotify content in websites.
- [Open Graph / Sharing Surface](https://open.spotify.com/): Public content pages for tracks, albums, playlists, and artists.
- [Spotify Codes](https://www.spotifycodes.com/): Spotify’s visual code-sharing experience for music and podcast content.
- [Podcast and Music Sharing](https://www.spotify.com/us/brand-center/): Brand-related resources relevant to shared Spotify visual assets.

## Company and Product Surfaces
- [Spotify Home](https://www.spotify.com/): Main consumer-facing Spotify website.
- [About Spotify](https://www.spotify.com/about-us/): Corporate overview and company information.
- [Newsroom](https://newsroom.spotify.com/): Official announcements, product news, and company updates.
- [Careers](https://www.lifeatspotify.com/): Hiring and culture site for Spotify roles worldwide.
